trashhunter_black_kameri_fur.author: TrashHunter
trashhunter_black_kameri_fur.description: The Kameri are a humaonid species with black and white striped fur which jokingly call themselves two-legged zebra. Usually black dominates the coat pattern and the stripes are white. Very rarely there is a variant in which white dominates as the basic color. This is the usual black dominated coat. Important: Kameri are hermaphrodite and always appear in female appearance. To reproduce a Kameri can turn her vagina inside out and reshape it into a penis to fertilize her mate. So please don't anyone come up with the idea of giving birth to male Kameri. They do not exist.
